comment.body:
Thanks for showing the Group Policy configuration and explaining that Config Manager controls the deployed version so users should not be prompted to update locally. The ambiguity is whether the displayed notification is governed by the configured ADMX policy or by a different update channel/version whose policy is not covered by the older templates. Please provide the exact policy name and value, the deployed package version and source, and reproduce before commenting /bugreport. This will distinguish a policy-version mismatch from a notification regression.

**Needed**
1. Please provide Exact update-notification policy name and value; Copy only the relevant policy name/value and redact organization details.
2. Please provide Deployed package version and source; State version and Config Manager/WinGet/Store source.
3. Please provide Fresh diagnostics after notification appears; Reproduce and comment /bugreport immediately afterward.
